subject: Invoice delivery options and VAT tagging — consolidated push vs customer pull
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Evans <laura.evans@acmetrade.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options and VAT tagging — consolidated push vs customer pull

Hi Laura,

Following our onboarding call yesterday I wanted to confirm how Acme would prefer to receive invoices from Redwood going forward. We support a few production options and want to align on whichever is easiest for your AP team:

- Monthly consolidated invoice (one PDF + CSV remittance per legal entity) pushed from Redwood via SFTP or email to ap-team@acmetrade.com; we can include PO mappings and a reconciliation CSV.
- Portal pull: Acme enrolls in the Redwood Billing Portal (one-time enrollment) and pulls invoices/UBL XML on demand; we also offer webhook notifications when new invoices are issued.
- Hybrid: portal primary with an automatic email copy (daily or monthly) to your AP mailbox.

A couple of VAT-specific items we need to confirm:
1) Do you need the invoice labelled for EU reverse charge (we can populate the reverse-charge clause and Acme VAT/registration number on the PDF and UBL)?
2) Do you require signed PDF invoices (signed-pdf) or is an unsigned PDF + UBL considered sufficient for your local tax team?
3) Any PO number convention we should use when generating the CSV remittance to match your ledger (e.g. prefix ACME-PO)?

I attached an anonymized sample invoice + UBL example and a CSV template for remit mapping so you can forward to AP. If you prefer the portal we can fast-track an invite and webhook.

If you reply with your preference and VAT instructions we’ll prepare the first month’s payload for validation.

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample_invoice_202508.pdf (PDF, 78KB), ubl_example.xml (XML, 4KB), acme_remit_accounts.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Laura Evans <laura.evans@acmetrade.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 17 Aug 2025 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT tagging — consolidated push vs customer pull

Hi Rishi — thanks, this is super helpful. A few notes from AP: 

- Primary preference: consolidated monthly PDF pushed to ap-team@acmetrade.com (we ingest attachments nightly). Portal pull is fine for our internal users but AP prefers a push for automated ingestion.
- We need the invoice to include our VAT number and the wording "Reverse charge — Article 194" when reverse charge applies; I can send our VAT proof once you confirm where to attach it.
- Signed PDF is preferred for our auditors, but they can accept an unsigned PDF if the UBL contains the digital seal. Can Redwood produce a signed-pdf? If not, we can accept signed-by-Redwood UBL + unsigned PDF.
- PO mapping: please prefix PO numbers with ACME-; if no PO is provided, include an empty PO column rather than N/A.

Looping in AP group (ap-team@acmetrade.com) for any security/transfer constraints. Thanks for the attachments — I’ll review with finance and send VAT proof by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Laura
Director, Finance Operations
AcmeTrade

(On a separate note: is there a way to have the monthly CSV include our internal cost-center code? We can send the mapping.)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Evans <laura.evans@acmetrade.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice delivery options and VAT tagging — consolidated push vs customer pull

Kimberly / Marissa — please see Acme's reply below. Key asks: signed PDF preferred, reverse-charge wording required, PO prefix ACME-, monthly consolidated push to ap-team@acmetrade.com, include empty PO column if missing. They may provide VAT proof tomorrow.

Questions for ops/engineering:
- Can we enable signed PDF in our outbound pipeline for this customer? If not, can we produce a digitally-sealed UBL and unsigned PDF as the fallback?
- SFTP vs email push: they prefer email ingestion but we should verify file size limits and whether they require TLS or an encrypted bundle.
- CSV fields: add cost_center column (they will provide mapping).

Can we commit to a pilot delivery for the 31 Aug billing run (invoice dated 31 Aug) so Acme has a validation invoice before month-end?

Thanks — Rishi

Attachments forwarded: sample_invoice_202508.pdf, ubl_example.xml, acme_remit_accounts.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice delivery options and VAT tagging — consolidated push vs customer pull

Rishi — we can support both paths but with a couple constraints:

1) Signed PDF: Our current PDF pipeline does not produce an RFC-compliant cryptographic signature for every customer. We can add a PAdES signature (visible signature) but that requires legal sign-off and will add ~2 business days to the rollout.
2) UBL: We already generate a valid UBL XML artifact for all EU invoices. We can add a digital seal element to the UBL which should satisfy the tax team's requirement in many jurisdictions.
3) Email push: We do TLS email delivery and can attach a zipped bundle with the PDF + UBL + CSV. For larger invoices we can offer SFTP instead.

Recommendation: Pilot with an emailed zipped bundle (TLS) for 31 Aug with unsigned PDF + sealed UBL + CSV (including cost_center column). If the customer requires a visibly signed PDF we should scope the PAdES work in a small-ticket sprint (2 dev days + legal review) and communicate timeline.

Marissa — can billing ops prepare the zipped payload and the CSV schema with an ACME-PO prefix and empty-cell PO handling? If yes, we can confirm pilot date with Laura today.

-Kimberly
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Evans <laura.evans@acmetrade.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options and VAT tagging — consolidated push vs customer pull

Laura / Rishi / Kimberly — we can do the pilot on 2025-08-31. Deliverable and acceptance criteria we’ll use for the pilot: 

- Payload: zipped bundle (invoice_20250831_ACME.zip) delivered via TLS email to ap-team@acmetrade.com containing:
  - invoice_20250831_ACME.pdf (unsigned PDF with human-readable reverse-charge clause when requested)
  - invoice_20250831_ACME.xml (UBL with digital seal element)
  - remit_20250831_ACME.csv (CSV with columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, net_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, ACME_PO, cost_center)

- Data: we will populate ACME_PO with provided PO or leave blank. We will include the VAT registration fields and the reverse-charge clause text.
- Security: file sent over TLS; if their environment has message size or retention restrictions we can fall back to SFTP (request credentials via secure portal).
- Acceptance: Acme AP confirms receipt + that CSV maps cleanly into their ledger and that the UBL/CSV contain the VAT attributes they require.

Laura — once you send VAT proof and cost_center mappings I will create the payload and send a validation note and a small sample bundle today so you can confirm layout.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_remit_accounts.csv (template).
